description:

title: National Lottery Data and Insights Analyst
description:
**About RSPCA Queensland**

For nearly 140 years, RSPCA Queensland has been a leading animal welfare charity, dedicated to improving the lives of animals \- whether domestic, farmed, or native. We care for over 42,000 animals annually, relying on the generosity of animal lovers like you to fund 91% of our life\-changing services.  



Our Mission: Together We Change Lives, And That Includes Yours.  



**About the Role**

RSPCA Queensland is relaunching the national RSPCA Lottery, and we are looking for a strategically minded **National Lottery Data \& Insights Analyst** who loves the challenge of driving revenue growth and finding the levers that make a lottery sing.  



Reporting to the National Lottery Manager, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating performance across a growing national program. This role sits at the heart of commercial decision\-making, where data, creativity and experimentation come together. You will analyse what is working, identify where to push harder, uncover opportunities to optimise campaigns, and help shape a lottery program built for scale, sustainability and long\-term impact.  



If you enjoy chasing targets, testing ideas, refining mechanics and watching revenue climb as a result of smart insights, this role offers that thrill, with the added bonus that every dollar raised directly helps animals in need. You will join a fun, highly engaged and supportive national team that genuinely enjoys what they do. We move fast, collaborate openly, celebrate wins, and back each other to try new things.  



**What We’re Looking For**

You are commercially curious and genuinely excited by performance. You enjoy asking “why”, “what if” and “how do we do this better?”. You are comfortable working with targets, ambiguity and fast\-moving priorities, and you thrive when you can see your insights directly influence outcomes.  



Just as importantly, you enjoy working with people. You are collaborative, open and confident communicating insights to stakeholders with varying levels of data literacy. You value teamwork, shared wins and building something bigger than yourself.  



**What You’ll Do**

In this role, you will:
* Analyse sales performance, supporter behaviour and market trends to identify growth opportunities, pressure points and untapped revenue levers.
* Deep dive into campaign performance to understand what drives sell\-outs, spikes in demand and sustained momentum.
* Build engaging dashboards, reports and presentations that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
* Support forecasting, budgeting and scenario modelling to help the team chase ambitious but achievable revenue targets.
* Test, optimise and evaluate lottery mechanics, pricing, prize mix and supporter journeys using data\-led experimentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion, retention and lifetime value across the supporter lifecycle.
* Partner closely with Marketing, Digital, Sales and Member Societies to turn insights into action and outcomes.
* Develop scalable reporting frameworks and data structures that support a growing national program.
* Champion data quality, governance and compliance while keeping insights practical and decision\-focused.
* Identify opportunities for automation, smarter tooling and advanced analytics to lift capability and efficiency.

  




This is not a passive reporting role. You will be actively shaping strategy, influencing decisions and helping the team pull the right levers to drive results.  



**What You’ll Bring to the Role*** Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Business Analytics or similar.
* Proven experience in data analysis, ideally in gaming, lottery or FMCG environments.
* Strong capability managing complex data sets within CRM systems.
* Proficiency with Tableau, Power BI or similar visualisation tools.
* A natural problem\-solver who thrives in fast\-paced, evolving environments and enjoys tackling complex challenges.
* Highly motivated and hands\-on, with a genuine passion for improving performance and outcomes through data and insight.
* Confident communicator with strong presentation skills and the ability to build trust with diverse stakeholders.
* A genuine interest in animal welfare and alignment with RSPCA Qld values.

  




**Why Join Us?**
* **A Fun, Supportive Team:** Join a passionate, collaborative national team that celebrates wins, supports growth and genuinely enjoys working together.
* **Commercial Challenge with Purpose:** Chase revenue, optimise performance and drive growth in a role where success directly improves animal welfare outcomes.
* **Real Influence:** Your insights will shape strategy, campaigns and decisions at a national level.
* **Professional Growth:** Access learning and development opportunities while working on a complex, evolving national program.
* **Purpose\-Driven Impact:** Every insight you deliver helps fund life\-changing services for animals across Australia.

  



At RSPCA Queensland, we encourage curiosity, ambition and growth. As the lottery program matures, so too do the opportunities to expand your impact, responsibilities and career pathways across the organisation.  


**Interested?**

If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you, **apply** **today****!**  

Successful candidates will be required to undergo a Police Check for the safety and well\-being of the community, staff, and animals. A pre\-employment medical assessment may also be required.  



RSPCA Queensland acknowledges the Australian Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the Traditional Custodians of the land. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to a fair and inclusive hiring process, welcoming applicants of all backgrounds, regardless of faith, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Business Analyst (Brisbane)
description:
**Fyfe is a multi\-disciplinary consultancy providing comprehensive engineering, environmental, planning and surveying services throughout Australia. With over 1000 employees, Fyfe delivers projects with a wide range of clients in the Property \& Infrastructure, Energy \& Resources, Defence and Renewables sectors to provide high quality, commercially pragmatic solutions with a strong focus on client service and delivery.**


**About the Opportunity**

  


Fyfe is looking for a high\-impact Business Analyst who will sit at the heart of the business, turning complex project and financial data into clear, actionable insights that directly influence performance, client outcomes, and decision\-making. This role owns the data\-to\-decision pipeline; driving smarter reporting, automation, and continuous improvement across a fast\-moving, project\-based environment. The position can be based in Melbourne, Adelaide or Brisbane.


**What will you be doing?**

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver data\-driven insights.
* Extract and manage datasets from project management systems, acting as the central link to ensure consistent, accurate, and reconcilable data.
* Develop and maintain KPIs, dashboards, and analytical reports to monitor performance across key client activities.
* Lead or support automation and digitisation initiatives to enhance client analysis and reporting efficiency.
* Deliver clear, customer\-focused reporting, analysis, and insights that provide actionable guidance to management and internal stakeholders.
* Interpret and transform large, complex datasets into meaningful and actionable insights; proficiency in financial reporting, accounts, and methodologies is advantageous.
* Identify process inefficiencies and design improved future\-state workflows.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support cultural change toward data\-driven decision\-making.


**Your background and experience:**


**T**o fulfil the requirements of this role you have high attention to detail and can demonstrate your analytical skills and passion for reporting and analysis, along with:


* Ability to quickly learn project management systems and act as a key liaison between business unit teams and data outputs.
* Tertiary qualifications in Business, Commence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Strong financial modelling capability with advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI, Power Query and/or SQL Server Databases is PREFERRED.
* Demonstrated experience in financial analysis or commercial finance within project\-based or complex operating environments.
* Confident communicator with the ability to educate and influence non\-financial stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and accuracy, with the ability to perform effectively in a lean, fast\-paced environment.
* Previous experience in, and motivated by, working in a professional services environment.


**Why Fyfe:**


* We continue to work on our great culture to make it better
* We listen to our people
* A social, collaborative, and inclusive culture with a calendar full of social and networking events
* We create your next opportunity to ensure we support your career development
* Additional salary sacrificed purchased leave
* Employee discounts with over 470 leading retailers, including fuel and grocery discounts.
* Salary sacrifice novated lease, e\-bikes/e\-scooters and devices.


Fyfe embraces and fosters a culture that supports diversity, inclusion and respect, where people are empowered to fulfil their potential. We welcome people with diverse skills, experiences, perspectives and backgrounds. We are dedicated and committed to attracting and recruiting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and encourage applications from people with disability, people that identify as LGBTQIA\+ and people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds.


**How to apply**  

If you believe you meet the above criteria and would like to join our successful finance team,



Follow us on **LinkedIn** to keep up to date with our news and projects.


Please note only shortlisted candidates and those who are Australian Citizens, hold permanent residency will be contacted.
